programme.title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi

programme.title: Abhimaan

programme.title: Ghar Ghar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram suspects his younger brother Amar of having an affair with his wife Seeta. He continues to hold this belief even after Amar gets married to the love of his life, Asha.

programme.title: Khuda Gawah

programme.title: Gone Kesh
programme.desc: The film reflects the tale of a teenage girl Enakshi who is an ambitious dancer but is diagnosed with alopecia, a state where she starts losing hair at a rapid rate.

programme.title: Dhamaal

programme.title: The Legend of Bhagat Singh
programme.desc: During the British Raj, upon witnessing the atrocities of the British, Bhagat Singh grows up to be a fierce freedom fighter. His publicised ideas of revolution bring him to as much popularity as Mahatma Gandhi amongst Indians.
